content.comment_body: Hello! I can use the arrow keys while holding down 'esc', but I can't get the 'ok' and 'esc' buttons on my [product_name] to work in my program. Is there a way to enable this? Thank you! I'm working with [product_name] [version_no].
No, this isn't possible. In your program, only the cursor keys on the [product_name] and/or those on a [product_name] display module, plus the F keys on the same module, can be detected.
Is there a method to use the arrow keys without needing to hold the 'esc' button?

analysis.insight_summary: The main issue raised is the limited ability to program the 'ok' and 'esc' buttons on [company_name] hardware when using [product_name] software. Arrow keys can only be detected if the 'esc' button is pressed at the same time, which restricts interface customization and may reduce usability for navigation and confirmation actions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to program 'ok', 'esc', and arrow keys separately as inputs within their application logic.
